# vcp_llm_group (Resource)

Manages an LLM group: the set of catalog models its access keys may call. The project has to be connected to the LLM service (`vcp_llm_connection`).

~> Destroying the group disables it together with all its access keys; it cannot be enabled again. A disabled group stays in the project with `state = "disabled"`, and its name cannot be used for a new group: creating one with it fails with `GroupAlreadyExists`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "vcp_llm_models" "catalog" {
  depends_on = [vcp_llm_connection.this]
}

# A group that may call every text model of the local contour.
resource "vcp_llm_group" "backend" {
  name = "backend"
  model_ids = [
    for m in data.vcp_llm_models.catalog.models : m.id
    if m.kind == "text" && m.contour == "local" && m.is_available_to_groups
  ]
  tags = ["production"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name, unique within the project, including its disabled groups. Changing it disables the group and creates a new one, with new access keys.

### Optional

- `model_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the catalog models (`vcp_llm_models`) the group may call. The set is applied whole; omitting it or an empty set revokes every model.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags of the group. The set is applied whole; omitting it or an empty set removes every tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Group ID.
- `state` (String) Group state: `active` or `disabled`. New states may be added over time.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# LLM groups can be imported by numeric ID.
terraform import vcp_llm_group.backend 42
```
